description: Exact official MiniMax H3 FL2VA partition (the original checkpoint layout under FL2VA/, the folder the creator's two-Spark vLLM-Omni stack loads) for text-to-video-and-audio and first/last-keyframe generation. The text encoder, VAEs, processors and tokenizers are byte-identical to the Ref2VA partition; the transformer differs.
